body_text:
A projection is a linear operator $P:V\to V$ satisfying
$P^2=P$. One has the canonical direct-sum decomposition
$V=\operatorname{im}P\oplus\ker P$, and $P$ acts as the
identity on its image and as zero on its kernel.
